definitions.margin: graph score minus BM25 score on the same questions (hit@5, or answer accuracy)
definitions.test: exact two-sided sign test on per-question pairs (eval/e2e_qa_swap.sign_test)
definitions.verdict: beats: margin>0 and p<0.05; below: margin<0 and p<0.05; n.s. otherwise
definitions.holm: Holm-Bonferroni over the cells of one arm (30 per arm per level/reader)
definitions.flip: aligned verdict 'beats' and independent verdict not 'beats'
definitions.kendall_tau: scipy.stats.kendalltau (tau-b) between the item scores under the aligned and the independent KG; BM25 and dense-only are identical in both arms
definitions.answer_metric: alias-aware EM; GraphRAG-Bench: Mistral-Small-24B judge accuracy reconstructed per question from results/e2e_qa/judge_cache_mistral_small_24b.jsonl

caption_draft: Graph-over-BM25 hit@5 margin of each graph retriever with the gold-aligned KG (circles) and with an independent OpenIE KG (squares), on the first split (large) and the held-out split (small); filled markers beat BM25 and crossed markers fall below it by an exact paired sign test ($p<0.05$). With the aligned KG 24 of 30 benchmark--split--retriever cells beat BM25; with the independent KG 5 do, and 19 verdicts flip (Holm over the 30 cells of an arm: 20, 3, and 17).
